title: OS Command Injection in p_3.c
description: blind audit sample_001.c: validate_cmd truncates on ';','|','&','$' but omits backticks/newline, and the resulting string still reaches system() unsandboxed - command injection.

title: SQL Injection in 1.py
description: blind audit sample_003.py: SQL DELETE built with %-string formatting of user_input directly into the query - classic SQL injection.

title: NULL Pointer Dereference in p_3.c
description: blind audit sample_004.c: fopen() return value is used in fgets() without a NULL check (and argv[3] is read without validating argc) - NULL pointer dereference.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in 3.c
description: blind audit sample_006.c: validate_hostname never NUL-terminates valid_hostname, so strcpy in get_hostname over-reads and overflows the fixed 64-byte hostname buffer.

title: Path Traversal in 3.c
description: blind audit sample_007.c: print_file concatenates dir+file_name with no '..'/traversal check before fopen - path traversal.

title: Path Traversal in 1.c
description: blind audit sample_008.c: resolved_path from realpath() is computed but never used or validated against dir; the raw, unsanitized file_path is opened instead - path traversal.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in 1.c
description: blind audit sample_010.c: buf is declared int buf[3] (valid indices 0-2) but buf[3] is written - out-of-bounds stack write.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in 3.c
description: blind audit sample_011.c: validate_hostname's missing NUL terminator combines with a missing length check on len, guaranteeing a heap buffer overflow via strcpy into the 64-byte hostname.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in p_3.c
description: blind audit sample_014.c: Same broken validate_hostname (no NUL terminator) as other hostname samples; the added len>MAX_NAME_LEN check does not stop the strcpy over-read/overflow.

title: Path Traversal in 2.c
description: blind audit sample_017.c: realpath() is applied only to the base 'dir', not to the final path; file_name (which may contain '../') is concatenated in unchecked before fopen - path traversal.

title: NULL Pointer Dereference in 3.c
description: blind audit sample_018.c: fopen(file,'r') result is passed to fgets without a NULL check, and argv[3] is dereferenced without checking argc - NULL pointer dereference.

title: NULL Pointer Dereference in p_1.c
description: blind audit sample_019.c: initialize_data overwrites the just-malloc'd data[i] pointers with the integer len_init (0/NULL when init_chars is empty), so callers dereference a garbage/NULL pointer.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in 2.c
description: blind audit sample_020.c: dst_buf is sized 4*MAX_SIZE+1 bytes, but '&' expands to 5 chars ('&'), so a string of '&' characters overflows the heap buffer.

title: Integer Overflow in 1.c
description: blind audit sample_021.c: num_char is multiplied by sizeof(char*) with no overflow guard, so a large num_char wraps the malloc size and the following per-element writes go out of bounds.

title: OS Command Injection in 3.c
description: blind audit sample_022.c: validate_cmd only screens for ';' and lets '|','&','$', and backticks straight through into system() - command injection.

title: SQL Injection in p_3.py
description: blind audit sample_024.py: createQuery builds a SQL string via '%s' placeholders filled with username/password taken directly from request input - SQL injection.

title: Use After Free in 1.c
description: blind audit sample_025.c: full_name is passed to free() and then used in printf('%s', full_name) afterward - use-after-free.

title: Path Traversal in p_2.c
description: blind audit sample_028.c: realpath()'s result is only checked for NULL, never verified to stay inside dir, before the concatenated (unsanitized) path is opened - path traversal.

title: Integer Overflow in 3.c
description: blind audit sample_030.c: get_collective_sum adds rand_num into sum with no SHRT_MAX bound check before the addition - short integer overflow.

title: SQL Injection in 2.py
description: blind audit sample_032.py: find_book concatenates user_input directly into the SQL string instead of using a bound parameter - SQL injection.

title: Path Traversal in 1.c
description: blind audit sample_034.c: read_file concatenates file_name onto a fixed dir with no traversal check whatsoever before fopen - path traversal.

title: Cross-site Scripting in 3.py
description: blind audit sample_035.py: create_output concatenates the raw 'day' form value directly into the HTML response with no escaping - reflected XSS.

title: Use After Free in 2.c
description: blind audit sample_036.c: On a failed fopen the loop frees the shared 'data' buffer but keeps iterating; a later successful fopen calls fgets on the already-freed pointer - use-after-free.

title: OS Command Injection in 2.c
description: blind audit sample_037.c: print_file builds 'cat <file_path>' and passes it straight to system() with zero validation of file_path - command injection.

title: Path Traversal in 2.c
description: blind audit sample_038.c: realpath()'s result is only checked for NULL, never confirmed to stay under dir, before the file is opened - path traversal.

title: SQL Injection in 3.py
description: blind audit sample_039.py: createQuery performs 'query_text % parmeters', embedding username/password directly into the SQL text before execute() runs it - SQL injection.

title: OS Command Injection in 1.c
description: blind audit sample_040.c: list_directory only checks dir's length, never its content, before strcat-ing it into cmd and calling system() - command injection.

title: Path Traversal in p_1.c
description: blind audit sample_041.c: resolved_path from realpath() is computed but discarded; the raw file_path is concatenated into full_path and opened instead - path traversal.

title: NULL Pointer Dereference in p_2.c
description: blind audit sample_042.c: dir is assigned from a multi-character char literal instead of a string literal, producing an invalid pointer that strlen(dir)/strcpy(path,dir) dereference and crash on.

title: Cross-site Scripting in 2.py
description: blind audit sample_043.py: The SQL query is parameterized, but title is reflected into the HTML response unescaped ('%s found' % title) - reflected XSS.

title: Cross-site Scripting in 1.py
description: blind audit sample_044.py: username is concatenated unescaped into the HTML response even though the SQL lookup itself uses bound parameters - reflected XSS.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in p_3.c
description: blind audit sample_045.c: Same bug as the other hostname samples: validate_hostname never NUL-terminates its buffer, so strcpy in get_hostname over-reads/overflows.
